title: GUARDIANS OF THE AGENTIC SYSTEM: PREVENTING MANY SHOT JAILBREAKING WITH AGENTIC SYSTEM
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and security, specifically many-shot jailbreaking and agentic alignment (detecting rogue or deceptive agents). While it uses terms like 'Ethical Deployment' and 'Responsible AI', the core evaluation methodology is technical (adversarial attacks, tool-mediated security, and jailbreak prevention) rather than a study of moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious beliefs.
